from collections import Counter
out=[r[:] for r in grid]
for i in range(len(grid)):
 for j in range(len(grid[0])):
  if grid[i][j] in (0,9):
   ns=[grid[a][b] for a,b in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)) if 0<=a<len(grid) and 0<=b<len(grid[0]) and grid[a][b] not in (0,9)]
   c=Counter(ns)
   if c and c.most_common(1)[0][1]>=2: out[i][j]=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
   else: out[i][j]=6
# any outstanding object holes 6 within regions? not needed
print(out)
